related.title: SQLite：外鍵、孤兒列與匯入順序
related.titleEn: SQLite: foreign keys, orphans and import order
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：為缺測溫度建立 TRUE、FALSE、UNKNOWN 真值表，確認 WHERE 與 COUNT 的行為。 驗收紀錄必須包含通過/失敗、重現方式和剩餘限制；只對已檢查的模型範圍作結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Build TRUE,FALSE,UNKNOWN tables for missing temperatures and distinguish WHERE from COUNT. Acceptance includes pass/fail,reproduction instructions and remaining limits; conclusions stay within the checked model.
related.difference: 對學員與選課資料建立外鍵，驗證匯入失敗可以回復整批。
related.differenceEn: Create student/enrolment foreign keys and verify batch import rollback.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: NULL 比較通常產生 UNKNOWN；WHERE 僅保留 TRUE，COUNT(column) 忽略 NULL 而 COUNT(*) 不忽略。 教學基準：5-2 = 3 non-null values；第二檢核：(18+22+30)/3 = 23.33333333 mean temperature。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
參照完整性約束的是子鍵是否有父鍵；SQLite 連線必須明確開啟並確認 foreign_keys。 教學基準：5-1 = 4 valid child rows；第二檢核：1/5*100 = 20 orphan percent。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: NULL comparisons usually produce UNKNOWN; WHERE retains TRUE and COUNT(column) ignores NULL while COUNT(*) does not. Teaching baseline: 5-2 = 3 non-null values; second check: (18+22+30)/3 = 23.33333333 mean temperature. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.

Referential integrity checks child keys against parent keys; explicitly enable and verify SQLite foreign_keys per connection. Teaching baseline: 5-1 = 4 valid child rows; second check: 1/5*100 = 20 orphan percent. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.difference: 用兩個工作階段追蹤同一交易內兩次 SELECT 可能看見不同已提交值。
related.differenceEn: Trace how two SELECTs inside one transaction can see different committed values across sessions.

PostgreSQL Read Committed 以每個陳述式的開始建立可見性快照，不保證交易全程重複讀取相同。 教學基準：20-3 = 17 second statement stock；第二檢核：20-17 = 3 observed change。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
